lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four identifiable horizontal rows, with local maxima spaced at regular intervals of approximately 15-20 pixels in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clear vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal rows of blobs at near-perpendicular angles, forming a distinct grid-like matrix of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the most dorsal ridge exhibits a sharp luminance transition with a high-intensity peak along the ridge line and a narrow shadow gradient immediately inferior to it.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated along the anterior margin and central surface, with lower density compared to the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp demarcation zone is visible where the fine-grained, high-frequency speckling of the cephalic region transitions into the larger, grid-organized macro-patterns of the trunk.
